title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the essential streets and corridors immediately surrounding Davidson College, where historic charm meets student life in the heart of North Carolina.

cards.title: The College Gateway
cards.subtitle: Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk the brick-lined sidewalks where the campus meets the town. This block houses the college's main entrance and the historic Grey House admission center.
cards.short_summary: The primary interface between Davidson College and the town's historic commercial district.
cards.evidence_claim: The college's main entrance is located at 405 North Main Street in Davidson, N.C., adjacent to the Grey House admission office.
cards.source_title: Grey House and Harding House - Davidson College

cards.title: Restaurant Row
cards.subtitle: Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this vibrant stretch known for nationally acclaimed dining and local boutiques. It serves as the social heart for students and residents alike.
cards.short_summary: A bustling commercial block south of the college known for its dense concentration of restaurants.
cards.evidence_claim: South Main Street is referred to as 'restaurant row' and is lined with numerous options and nationally acclaimed dining.
cards.access_notes: Public street with various business hours.

cards.title: The Academic Link
cards.subtitle: Concord Road Corridor
cards.notes: Follow this road to reach the Sloan Music Center and the Baker Sports Complex. It connects the central campus to major athletic and arts facilities.
cards.short_summary: A key corridor on the eastern edge of campus housing music and athletic venues.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sloan Music Center is located at 323 Concord Road, near the heart of campus and east of the Baker-Watt Science Complex.
cards.access_notes: Public road; facility hours vary by event.

cards.title: The Town Gateway
cards.subtitle: Griffith Street Corridor
cards.notes: Enter Davidson via this principal gateway. This block connects the I-77 interchange to the historic village center and the college's north side.
cards.short_summary: The primary western entrance to the town and college from the interstate.
cards.evidence_claim: Griffith Street is the principal gateway to the Town of Davidson and Davidson College, connecting to the village center.
cards.source_title: Griffith Street Corridor Plan - Davidson, NC

cards.title: Historic Rail District
cards.subtitle: Depot Street Corridor
cards.notes: Explore the area around the old train depot. It offers free all-day parking for visitors and is home to the Davidson Village Inn.
cards.short_summary: A historic street reflecting Davidson's railroad heritage, now featuring lodging and parking.
cards.evidence_claim: The Davidson Village Inn is located at 117 Depot Street, and the nearby church lot offers free all-day parking.
cards.access_notes: Public street; parking lot available Monday-Friday.

cards.title: The Administrative Circle
cards.subtitle: Jackson Court Corridor
cards.notes: Walk through Jackson Court, a semi-circle of nine historic houses. Originally fraternity lodges, they now house various college administrative offices.
cards.short_summary: A unique semi-circular street of historic homes used for college services.
cards.evidence_claim: Jackson Court is comprised of nine small houses in a semi-circle on the southeast side of campus, housing offices like Human Resources.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible court; office hours typically 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM.

cards.title: Residential Student Orbit
cards.subtitle: Catawba Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Stroll down this quiet residential street just blocks from campus. It is a popular area for off-campus student housing and local rentals.
cards.short_summary: A residential corridor providing housing options within walking distance of the college.
cards.evidence_claim: Catawba Avenue features various rental properties and townhomes popular with the Davidson community.

cards.title: The Greenway Connection
cards.subtitle: Lorimer Road Corridor
cards.notes: Access local greenways from this street. It connects the campus area to Davidson's network of walking and biking trails.
cards.short_summary: A street providing access to the town's recreational trail system.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenways connect neighborhoods to Main Street and Davidson College, with access points near Lorimer Road.
cards.source_title: Discover Downtown Davidson NC Shops and Cafes

cards.title: The Parkside Corridor
cards.subtitle: Beaty Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk toward Roosevelt Wilson Park along this corridor. It serves as a transition between the commercial downtown and residential areas.
cards.short_summary: A corridor linking the downtown core to local parks and residential neighborhoods.
cards.evidence_claim: Beaty Street is part of the Griffith Street Corridor Plan, connecting to local parks and residential districts.
cards.source_title: Griffith Street Corridor Plan - Davidson, NC

cards.title: The Social District Extension
cards.subtitle: Watson Street Corridor
cards.notes: Explore this block recently added to the town's social district. It connects the Main Street shops to the emerging Sadler Square area.
cards.short_summary: A street bridging the historic downtown with new commercial developments.
cards.evidence_claim: The Main Street social district was expanded to include Watson Street and reach toward Sadler Square.
cards.source_title: Town to expand main street social district - Davidsonian
cards.access_notes: Public street; social district rules apply for alcohol consumption.
